title: Not-quite-human tastes: the stylized omnivorousness of LLM survey surrogates.
reasoning: The paper focuses on cultural tastes and consumption patterns (music genres) and their associations with demographic factors like gender, race, and age. While it refers to literature on moral judgments and includes 'gospel' as a music genre, it does not evaluate or benchmark faith, morals, or ethics as a primary component of its research.
